newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish repo allocates 14 bln SKR to market.
newsitem.headline: Swedish repo allocates 14 bln SKR to market.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, said on Tuesday it allocated 14 billion crowns to the market in its weekly repurchase operation.
The one-week repo was set at an unchanged, fixed rate of 4.10 percent as expected by the market and will run from July 9 to July 16.
The operation replaces an operation that allocated 12 billion crowns to the market.
The Riksbank said 65.12 percent of the bids for the tender were allocated.
